title: A Portrait of the Artist as a Young Man
author: James Joyce
summary: Stephen Dedalus grows from a sensitive child in Ireland into a young man who rejects his Catholic upbringing, family and nation in order to become an artist. The prose changes as he ages.
readIf: you want an inward, language-focused novel about growing up and finding your vocation.
skipIf: you want an eventful story with a lot of external action.
